headline: WATCH batch 5 seats three proven pilots
lede: Lode Runner-Lite, Arena Archery and WWI Dogfight now fly themselves at the press of Y — each title's own harness-proven autopilot, no new brains.

notes.text: WATCH rollout batch 5 shipped (#1637/PR #1686): BFS vault solver, archery duel bot and the WWI gunnery pilot seat behind the Y key; arcade coverage now 36 of 80 routes.
CI static earned its keep: attract teach-line must be a span and the attract WATCH pill a 24% clear band — two rounds of fixes before merge, watchphonecheck + attractcheck now in the pre-push sweep.
Arena Archery's bot-vs-bot opening can stalemate 15-20 s until the stuck-arrow TTL reopens the duel — filed to QA as #1685.
